mods.name: Player Ping
mods.description: Check player ping and IP addresses on your server. A server-side port of the PingPlayer paper plugin.

releases.notes:
### Fabric version of the PingPlayer mod 1.1.1

- Fixed critical error causing server crashes with the mod across versions 1.21.5 to 1.21.11.
- Fixed bad detection of op users not being able to change threshold and use admin commands.
- Added luckperms roles support.

mods.name: Player Ping
mods.description: Check player ping and IP addresses on your NeoForge server. A server-side port of the PingPlayer Bukkit plugin.

releases.notes:
## PlayerPing 1.1.0

### Added
- Added `/pingplayer threshold` command family for operator-managed ping tiers.
- Added support for threshold modes:
  - `equal-or-more <value>`
  - `equal-or-less <value>`
  - `equal <value>`
  - `<min> <max>` interval mode
- Added command suggestions/tab-completion for threshold configuration.
- Added `/pingplayer threshold <tier>` to display the current range for a tier.
- Added overlap validation to prevent two tiers from sharing intersecting ranges.
- Added support for both Fabric and NeoForge release artifacts in this version line.

### Changed
- Threshold updates now apply immediately and are persisted to `config/player-ping/config.json`.
- Ping quality logic now uses explicit tier ranges (`excellent`, `good`, `fair`, `poor`, `terrible`) instead of fixed legacy cutoffs.
- Config loading now auto-migrates legacy keys (`medium`, `bad`) to the new tier model.
- Help output updated with new threshold syntax and examples.

### Removed
- Removed `/pingplayer reload` (no longer needed because changes are live-applied).

### Fixed
- Fixed command UX issue where symbol-based comparators (`>=`, `<=`, `=`) were not compatible with minecraft chat by replacing them with text comparators.
- Fixed potential ambiguous behavior from overlapping ranges by rejecting conflicting updates.

No dependencies needed for NeoForge loader
